market_name: Will 8 Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check whether the shift is idiosyncratic to this Polymarket strike or corroborated by fed funds futures / SOFR moves.
time_plan.1h: Compare against 2y and 10y yield moves; a genuine dovish repricing should show up in front-end rates first.
time_plan.2h: Look for a macro catalyst (weak data, risk-off, credit event) that would justify 8 cuts; absence suggests noise.
time_plan.6h: Re-assess whether the probability move persisted or mean-reverted; check overnight rates markets.
time_plan.12h: Evaluate realized TLT return vs expectation and whether easing narrative held into the close.

predictions.reasoning: An extreme-dovish market (8 cuts = 200bps of easing in 2026) rising in implied probability signals expectations of aggressive Fed easing, typically driven by sharp deterioration in growth/labor or a crisis. That collapses front-end rates and pulls down the long end, lifting long-duration Treasury prices. TLT is the most liquid duration proxy.

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Verify DXY direction and real-yield (TIPS) moves to confirm the dovish channel.
time_plan.1h: Check whether gold move is dollar-driven or haven-driven; distinguish from generic risk-on.
time_plan.2h: Look for confirming macro headline; if none, treat as weak signal.
time_plan.6h: Reassess persistence of dollar weakness and rate repricing.
time_plan.12h: Compare realized GLD return to expected and note whether the easing thesis survived.

predictions.reasoning: A jump in the probability of deep 2026 easing implies lower real rates and a weaker dollar, both supportive of gold. Gold also benefits if the easing expectation is tied to recession or crisis risk (safe-haven bid). It is a clean, liquid proxy for a dovish/weak-dollar shock.

evidence_used: Market strike: 8 cuts (200bps) in 2026 — an extreme-dovish outcome
Standard macro transmission: deep Fed easing expectations lower rates, weaken USD, support gold and long duration
Liquidity of TLT and GLD as macro proxies
uncertainty_notes: A rising probability of 8 cuts is ambiguous: it could reflect crisis/recession fear (risk-off, equities down) rather than a clean rate-relief rally.
Polymarket depth on a low-probability tail strike is thin; implied-probability moves may be noise, not information.
The 700bps tradable threshold is far above realistic 12h moves for these liquid instruments, so neither prediction is tradable.

llm_justification.summary: This is a mislabeled (tagged military_conflict) but clearly a Fed-policy market on an extreme-dovish tail (8 cuts/200bps in 2026). A sharp increase in its implied probability would signal expectations of aggressive easing—usually growth deterioration or crisis—implying lower rates (long Treasuries up) and a weaker dollar plus real yields (gold up). Both mappings are macro-plausible but low-confidence: the signal is ambiguous between rate-relief and recession fear, the strike is a thin tail, and realistic 12h moves fall well short of the 700bps tradable bar.
key_assumptions: The probability move reflects genuine dovish repricing, not thin-market noise.
Standard rates/FX/gold transmission holds over a 12h horizon.
No offsetting risk-off equity crash dynamic that scrambles cross-asset correlations.
failure_modes: The easing expectation is driven by recession/crisis fear, triggering a flight that could still lift Treasuries/gold but with very different equity co-movement and possible reversals.
The information is already public (a dovish data print or Fed comment already priced), so no residual asset move follows.
Polymarket tail-strike liquidity is too thin for the implied probability to be informative—pure noise.
Proxies are only weakly exposed on a 12h basis; moves stay far below the 700bps tradable threshold, making this non-actionable.
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
